name: Textile
notes: Avoided virgin fibre production (cotton, polyester, wool blended average). Pure cotton is ~5.0, synthetics ~2.7. Blended fabrics reduce this figure.

name: E-waste
source: EPA WARM Model v16 — Electronics category (2023)
notes: Avoided primary smelting of copper, gold, palladium, and other rare metals. Varies widely by device type; PCBs are significantly higher.

name: Metal
source: World Steel Association — Steel Recycling Factsheet (2023)
notes: Assumes a steel/iron mix. Aluminium is approximately 8.0 kg CO₂/kg. Copper is approximately 3.5. Update this category or split into sub-categories for accuracy.

name: Plastic
notes: Blended average across PET, HDPE, LDPE, PP. PET bottles are approximately 1.9. Mixed/contaminated plastic streams are lower at approximately 0.8.

name: Paper
notes: Avoided pulp production and deforestation emissions. Includes avoided methane from paper in landfill. Cardboard is slightly higher at approximately 1.0.

name: Organic
source: IPCC AR6 — Waste chapter; Carbon Trust composting LCA
notes: Avoided methane (CH4) from anaerobic decomposition in landfill, converted to CO₂ equivalent at 28× GWP (100yr). Assumes composting or biogas as the alternative.

name: Construction
source: BRE (Building Research Establishment) — ICE Database v3
notes: Blended average for concrete rubble, brick, and inert fill. Timber offcuts are approximately 0.9. Assumes crushed aggregate reuse displacing quarried material.

name: Glass
source: British Glass — CO2 Emissions Reduction by Glass Recycling (2023)
notes: Avoided silica sand extraction and high-temperature furnace energy. Lower than other materials because glass can only be recycled into lower-value cullet at scale.

name: Other
source: Conservative generic default — update when category is specified
notes: Fallback for products without a recognised category. Replace with a category-specific factor whenever possible.
